title: The Tools Changed, The Job Didn't: An Enterprise AE's Take on AI in Sales
summary: The episode explores how enterprise sales has evolved over 15+ years, particularly through the lens of AI's impact on sales workflows. Rich Strom discusses his journey from cold calling to closing six-figure maritime deals, examining how sales tools have historically burdened rather than empowered reps.
keyQuote: The tools changed. The job didn't.
guestBio: Enterprise SaaS sales professional with 15+ years of experience, progressing from cold calling to closing six-figure deals in maritime shipping at Sedna. Recently transitioned from sales management back to an individual contributor role.
